bases.name: Guardian Flight / GFL 213 (rotor) + GFL 042 (fixed) – Grand Rapids, MN
bases.limitation: Approximate Grand Rapids-Itasca County Airport facility reference. GFL 213 helicopter and GFL 042 fixed-wing programs are represented together at airport scale; this does not establish a shared hangar. Exact current aircraft parking positions remain unestablished. The off-airport Donovan Drive directory point is not used.

sources.purpose: Public September 2026 list identifies GFL 213 rotor-wing and GFL 042 fixed-wing in Grand Rapids. Roseau is a retained program name, not a second aircraft base.
Operator June 2023 announcement confirms the Grand Rapids helicopter joining an existing fixed-wing operation serving since August 2016.
Current operator identifies Grand Rapids program. Off-airport directory address is not treated as an aircraft launch location; RW in URL does not override public program classification.
Public air-transport facility registration at 1500 SE 7th Avenue Unit O, updated June 2023. Registration supports the airport facility but is not by itself proof of current flights.
2016 city airport lease identifies Valley Med Flight PC-12 air-ambulance operations at 1500 SE 7th Avenue. Historic lease corroborates airport assignment, not current individual hangar occupancy.
City 2017 annual report included in May 2018 packet records utility extension for a new Valley Med Flight hangar; the historic lease is not assumed to be the current hangar.
2026 Arrowhead EMS conference guide, PDF page 52, includes Guardian Flight Grand Rapids sponsorship with fixed-wing imagery; supplementary current presence evidence.
Airport facility address geocode, inspected against public aerial imagery. Approximate facility reference, not a surveyed aircraft parking position.
Airport hangar/apron context for mapped facility reference.
